# agentic-link

Share a document as a link: the content lives in the URL, with no account and no server read.

Keywords: share,link,url,snapshot,privacy,encryption,no-account,agents,mcp,cli.

- SDK: import { summarizeText, dispatchText } from "agentic-link".
- CLI: agentic-link summary --text "...".
- MCP: run agentic-link mcp, then call summarize_text.

## Docs
